description: The linked reader's Picks for today: the books the Siftivo app shows them on its Today page, chosen from their taste, each with why it was picked and what it is about. Suits "what should I read next?" and "recommend me a book" when the reader names no book or mood. Reading them here leaves the reader's streak alone; answering them in the app counts the day. Needs a linked Siftivo account.
name: get_my_picks
title: Get my Picks
